verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships a first-party GitHub integration. Mentioning /opencode or /oc in a comment runs the task in a GitHub Actions runner, works in a new branch and submits a PR, with guided app, workflow and secrets setup. The evidence shows no GitLab, Linear or Slack triggers, so only one of the four named platforms is covered. Missing for 10: GitLab trigger, Linear trigger, Slack trigger, independent or hands-on corroboration of the GitHub flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: OpenCode integrates with your GitHub workflow. Mention /opencode or /oc in your comment, and OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
This will walk you through installing the GitHub app, creating the workflow, and setting up secrets.
